thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: need final benchmark narrative for launch (next Thursday). Core promise: predictable inference economics — show how teams choose latency profile to hit budget/SLOs. I uploaded new sample data. Thoughts on hero treatment?
Samir Patel: We should highlight choice, not rank. Idea: hero = scatter with cost-isocurves (contours of equal $/1k tokens) so readers can pick a point for their SLA. Quick mock?
Nora Lim: Love contours — more visual than raw dots. For marketing copy: "Pick the latency that fits your UX and budget". Short, benefits-first.
Leo Ramirez: Contours are cool. Tech ask: include a tiny toggle for caching on/off to show credible savings. From the latest sim caching cuts cost ~15% for typical chat patterns.
Anya Volkov: I'll prototype 2 hero variants: A) contour bands + annotated callouts B) simple scatter with tooltips. Will also make a compact bar for the one-pager.
Priya Shah: Routing rules: primary CTA = "Estimate your serving cost" (self-serve calc). If user estimate >= 75k tokens/mo OR selects "enterprise" -> route to SDR. Also tag leads with est_tokens, chosen_latency_ms, and variant.
Maya Chen: Good. New staging numbers I dropped in /staging/bench/latency_cost_2026_03.csv — snippet below:
```
model,median_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k
redwood-v3,85,140,0.26
open-13b-quant,170,300,0.12
compat-lite,320,480,0.06
```
Maya Chen: Note: redwood-v3 tuned kernels show much tighter tail than the compat-lite line.
bench-bot: benchmark refresh finished 1765558888. Files: /staging/bench/latency_cost_2026_03.csv. Cache-sim results: cache_on reduces cost by ~15%. No anomalies detected. :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: Draft narrative outline: 1) TL;DR (value prop) 2) Hero viz (contour + toggle) 3) How to read it (p50/p95/p99 explainer) 4) Use cases (assistant vs search vs rerank) 5) CTA + routing.
Nora Lim: Webinar idea: "Operational inference: designing for latency and cost" — 25 min demo + 15 Q&A. Promo blurb: "See real workloads and our cost calculator live."
Anya Volkov: I'll build two hero GIFs: slow->fast sweep and cache toggle. Need final copy by Tue EOD to finish assets.
Leo Ramirez: I'll add a small sanity-check script in repo: `tools/check_bench_nums.sh --path staging/bench --min-samples 5000` so we can validate publishing numbers.
Priya Shah: Social copy variants ready for test: Speed-first: "Faster UX, predictable cost. See the tradeoffs." Econ-first: "Control inference spend while preserving quality. Try the calculator." We'll A/B by audience segment (devs vs PMs).
Maya Chen: Owners: Nora -> hero copy + webinar promo, Anya -> visuals, Samir -> one-pager + landing copy, Priya -> routing tags + lead flows, Leo -> validation script. Delivery checkpoints: scatter mock by Mon noon, copy baseline Tue morning, assets Wed EOD, publish Thu.
Samir Patel: One small ask: include region split on the scatter (US / EU / APAC) to surface any variance. I'll wire that into the interactive.
Nora Lim: OK I'll add microcopy for region notes. Also propose a short customer vignette: "How Acme reduced 30% serving spend by shifting from generic endpoint to latency-targeted profile." (fictional, for narrative).
Maya Chen: Good call. Final: please log any material deviations from previous benchmarks here. If nobody flags, we'll proceed with plan. :rocket:
Priya Shah: I'll post routing doc and the SDR handoff checklist after lunch.
Samir Patel: Adding copy variants to docs repo now.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — off to meetings, keep updates concise here.
